intent_en: To illustrate the proposed increase in the maximum capital gains tax rate in the context of its historical levels.
previous_intent: To illustrate the historical fluctuations of the maximum long-term capital gains tax rate in the United States and introduce a proposed increase by the Biden administration for high-income earners.
narration_support: President Biden has proposed closing that stepped up loophole and increasing the maximum tax rate
chart_support: line chart showing the maximum capital gains tax rate history from 1960 to 2020 and a proposed future increase
evidence_note: The narration discusses a proposal to raise tax rates and the resulting debate, while the chart visualizes the historical tax rate trend and highlights the proposed increase.
